Initial loss recommendation is superseded; do not use forfeitGame for ordinary expiry. Correct thinking-time versus ink terminology; Director explicitly selects existing engine replenishing timer, defined legal defaults otherwise pause, automatic pass and audited infrastructure/time pause, with upstream core/rules unchanged except demonstrated repair. D12 records final policies. Read actual native timer modes/helpers/history APIs and preserve loss/drop helpers as unselected behavior. Director explicitly approves the written PLAY-04 clock design after it is presented. Preserve the earlier proposal/review checkpoint and advance to implementation planning; no product implementation or new clock acceptance yet. Commit approved written design/intake as2033396, then prepare the five-task implementation plan with native engine reuse, typed clock controls/audited reset, fenced storage, server health/timeout runner, distinct live3 and browser estimates, precise checks and final review. RUN026 passes native documentation consistency after approved written design and prepared five-task implementation plan. Final source whitespace/application-preservation review passes; all app/upstream/config/dependency/test bytes remain unchanged. Plan review/execution-method choice remains pending.

Director approves implementation plan and explicitly selects native execution. Apply executing-plans/TDD with one final independent reviewer, existing scoped branch/container and sequential heavy checks. Scratch ledger /tmp/play04-native-ledger.md is supplementary; repository CHG/HANDOFF remain universal authority. Current verified feature entries marked pending as new executable test/source work begins.

Task1 writes closed policy/projection and actual adapter-clock tests before implementation: native125-second timeout pass arithmetic, pause/history/ref/replay preservation, invalid-command charging, audited reset/completion freeze and replay tampering. Capture expected negative run next.

Implement qualification clock policy/projection codecs, optional native dynamic kernel clock and preserved runtime-history controls, private-v2 deterministic control reconstruction and compiled clock-policy identity. No upstream runtime/rules patch or player/Lab system authority added.

Append migration0005 and fenced match-role clock/reservation/event repository with atomic creation/commits, deadline ordering, disjoint system receipts and legacy raw-candidate bypass refusal. Add owning workspace contracts edge only; offline frozen install. Service runner/recovery/live3/client integration and full acceptance remain pending.

Both managed targets upgraded to0005 without changing old migrations; role and original match integration regressions pass.

Record native execution rulings in current handoff: preserve original checkout/container; native recorder replaces generic skill test wrappers/scratch inventory; qualify three-version range explicitly at Task4; workspace-only dependency; crash phase-pause defers deterministic healthy-interval settlement; legal timeout pass may naturally satisfy existing engine win rules without timeout forfeiture.

Maintain partial current function/package/runbook/ADR/validation ownership, planned/unaccepted clock feature, source verification pending, unchanged548 requirements/optional/disposition gates with scoped prerequisite links, and complete cumulative branch coverage.

Task3 connects native timed jobs, monotonic-bracketed serialized database time health, short-reservation clock service, bounded non-overlapping runner, participant-only readClock and explicitly audited pause/reset/resume. Exact new-row creation ownership and observed independent heartbeat progress distinguish new/healthy servers from all-owner loss. Clock-only controls preserve engine version/card refs. Fair rotating storage scan avoids first-batch starvation. No host settings, upstream engine file or ordinary startup routes change.

Overlapping DB sample responses could falsely report calendar reversal. Added failing ordering regression RUN042, then serialized only time sampling; RUN043 passes. RUN041 test title overstated timely crossing: that original third case actually proves expired-lease fencing. Corrected its mutable test title and added a separate real timely-action/deadline-crossing test; RUN043 proves both.

Task4 implements a separately closed live3 family, version-bound tickets/gateway/reference commands, clock-only revision publication and a browser monotonic estimate with defensive lifecycle clearing. Diagnostic1/live2 remain exact. Shared bounded range deliberately expands to3adjacent revisions; manifests now bind1..3 only after handlers exist. Pending schema1 pins2 and schema2 pins3; retry never relabels commands. RUN045 expected negative precedes implementation;046 catches type narrowing;04716contract/10client checks and0482real live3 gateway tests pass.049 retains a fixture lint failure; corrected without changing policies.

Bound process boundary waits and retain deliberate short gap/lease only in explicit failure scenarios. RUN050 passes six-way duplicate race but fails one after-COMMIT child admission then is interrupted because its boundary wait is unbounded; the long receipt also fails unchanged clock guard. RUN051 passes all13 real process/fault checks with normal15-second health limits and a5-second COMMIT fixture lease. No production timing limit or host setting is relaxed.

RUN052 initial Chromium connection test fails;053 diagnostic test has a dynamic module typing startup error;054 passes after fixing that test URL. The initial receive failure remains undiagnosed, so a cold-cache proof without the extra diagnostic contract import is required. Preserve all outcomes; do not infer a fixed product bug from a retry.

Self-review adds RED055 then GREEN056 for completed-view versus running-clock consistency and native zero-start sentinel refusal. Clocked starts must be positive; untimed epoch-zero fixtures remain supported. This avoids native unset-start semantics without an upstream repair. Two independent private random worlds produce identical native clocks under the same time schedule.

RUN057 cold-cache Chromium reproduces an opening-command failure; original Vite cache restored. RUN058 passes with additional safe public frame/status diagnostics, which alone does not establish a fix. RUN059 explicitly exercises both chooser seats and fails both: processing revision1 is followed by running revision0 (and3→2 on the next opening move), then the client correctly refuses the rewind. The failure occurs during opening submission, not initial connection; this corrects earlier informal localization.

Write deterministic actual PostgreSQL blocked-heartbeat/read-snapshot regression and a simulated root-service shutdown sweep regression. Requested RUN060 is rejected before launch by automatic approval review after the Director instructs stop; no command result/log/receipt is fabricated. These new tests have not run. No production fix has been applied.

Save exact suspected stale-lock snapshot mechanism, proposed next proof/fix steps, unexecuted tests and full remaining qualification/review/commit tasks.

Fix clock-store.locked by rereading a fresh SQL snapshot after both row locks; do not reuse pre-wait sidecar values.
